verdicts.reason: Both make the same mistakes. The 'Weekend only' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, so the reading order is wrong. The headline is undersized for the canvas, and the body copy and 'Shop Sale' CTA are tiny, so the CTA is buried. The body line runs right up to the circle's edge, and there is a large empty band at the bottom. A is slightly less bad: its bigger bottle and lower CTA fill the height better, while B's smaller bottle and higher CTA leave even more dead space at the bottom.
